82:6.text: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

82:7.text: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

82:8.text: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

82:9.text: No! But you deny the Recompense.

82:13.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

82:14.text: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

82:15.text: burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

82:16.text: And never therefrom will they be absent.

82:17.text: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

82:18.text: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

82:19.text: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul
a thing; and the command, that Day, is

83:1.text: Woe to those who give less

83:2.text: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

83:3.text: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

83:4.text: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

83:6.text: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
